data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 gross claims outstanding were GBP 590.161m. During 2018 the Syndicate recorded adverse prioryear development (gross) of GBP 80.521m (13.6% of opening reserves), driven primarily by adverse claims development and large loss/catastrophe activity. The accounts note the impact of Hurricanes Florence and Michael and Californian wildfires for which reserves were established in 2018. The 2017 conclusion of an external reinsurancetoclose of 2008-2015 years materially affected opening/closing reserve comparatives (a large release related to the RITC was recorded).

data.data_quality_notes: Primary opening reserves taken from the statement of financial position (gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2017 = opening for 2018). Prior-year development (gross) taken from the Technical Provisions reconciliation row 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting years' (80,521 GBP 000). The accounts also record a large RITC (2015 & prior) movement which materially distorts year-to-year comparisons and LOB movements; several large movements (notably Third-party liability) reflect this reinsurance-to-close rather than organic reserve release. Some catastrophe amounts in the narrative are quoted in USD (not converted to GBP in the report) and therefore net_loss_gbp_m for those named events is null. The claims development triangle only contains UW years 2016-2018; older individual years (pre-2016) are not separately reported.
